name: Astro Sheet Metal Co., Inc.
old_description: Astro is a family-owned custom metal fabrication company founded in 1967 in Irving, Texas.
about:
Astro Sheet Metal Co., Inc. is a family-owned custom metal fabrication company founded in 1967 in Irving, Texas. The business, now headquartered in Grand Prairie, has operated for over five decades under continuous family ownership. The founders are not named in public materials.

The company provides architectural and industrial metal solutions. Its architectural metalwork scope covers design assistance, submittal drawings, mockups, fabrication, and installation, including custom brake metal forming up to 14 feet long and fabrication for subcontractors in glazing, millwork, drywall, and waterproofing. For general contractors, Astro delivers architectural metal packages in a range of finishes for bar areas, ceilings, elevator entries, and reception areas. On the industrial side, the shop serves food service and plant maintenance sectors with project consulting, custom fittings, hoppers, platforms, and transitions. Rush delivery is offered throughout the Dallas/Fort Worth and Austin metro areas.

Astro works with designers, builders, and contractors across commercial construction, healthcare, hospitality, retail, entertainment, education, and office development. Representative projects include architectural metalwork for the Amon Carter Museum in Fort Worth, the Bowie House Hotel, the OU Medical Center in Oklahoma City, the AMLI Fountain Place tower in Dallas, the Meow Wolf installation in Grapevine, and the College Station City Hall. The company also supports food service and plant maintenance clients with custom metal components.

Astro emphasizes a commitment to excellence, rapid turnaround times, and exceptional customer service as the foundation of its reputation. The firm positions itself as a partner that gives architects and builders the freedom to turn bold ideas into enduring structures, combining precision, artistry, and integrity in every cut, bend, and weld.
